div.div: مَفْنَاةٌ A land (أَرْضٌ) suitable to those who alight and abide therein: (K, TA:) it occurs, in a verse of Keys Ibn-El-'Eyzár El-Hudhalee, with ق, [as some relate that verse,] but As says that in the dial. of Hudheyl it is with ف. (TA in art. قنى.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
